segments.en:
Ahura Mazda spake unto Spitama Zarathushtra, 
saying: 'Do thou proclaim, O pure Zarathushtra! the 
vigour and strength, the glory, the help and the joy 
that are in the Fravashis of the faithful, the awful 
and overpowering Fravashis; do thou tell how they 
come to help me, how they bring assistance unto 
me, the awful Fravashis of the faithful.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達對斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉說，「純潔的查拉圖斯特拉啊，你要宣佈！力量與強健，光榮，幫助與歡樂，這些都在信者的弗拉瓦希裡，可怕而至強的弗拉瓦希；你要述說他們如何來幫助我，如何給我帶來援助，這些可怕的信者的弗拉瓦希。

'The most powerful amongst the Fravashis of the faithful, O Spitama!
are those of the men of the primitive law or those of the Saoshyants
not yet born, who are to restore the world. Of the others, the
Fravashis of the living faithful are more powerful, O Zarathushtra!
than those of the dead, O Spitama!
segments.zh:
在可怕的戰鬥中，他們是最聰慧的幫助，忠信者的弗拉瓦希。
忠信者的弗拉瓦希中最強大的，啊斯皮塔瑪！是那些原始法則的人的弗拉瓦希，或那些尚未出生的薩奧希揚特的弗拉瓦希，他們將使世界得到復興。在其他的中間，活著的忠信者的弗拉瓦希，啊查拉圖斯特拉！比死去者的弗拉瓦希更強大，啊斯皮塔瑪！

segments.zh: 因此我向你宣佈，啊純淨的斯皮塔瑪！忠信者的弗拉瓦希中所存在的活力與力量、光榮、幫助與喜樂，那可怕的、壓倒一切的弗拉瓦希；以及他們如何來幫助我，他們如何給我帶來援助，忠信者那可怕的弗拉瓦希。

segments.en:
Ahura Mazda spake unto Spitama Zarathushtra, saying: 'If in
this material world, O Spitama Zarathushtra! thou happenest to
come upon frightful roads, full of dangers and fears, O Zarathushtra!
and thou fearest for thyself, then do thou recite these words,
then proclaim these fiend-smiting words, O Zarathushtra!
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達對斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉說道：「假如在這物質世界中，啊斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！你恰好走上了可怕的道路，充滿了危險與恐懼，啊查拉圖斯特拉！而你為自己感到害怕，那麼你就應當誦唸這些言語，那麼你就應當宣佈這些擊殺魔鬼的言語，啊查拉圖斯特拉！

fravashayô staomi zbayemi ufyemi ýazamaide nmânyå
vîsyå zañtumå dâh'yumå zarathushtrôtemå
hâitish hâtãm hâitish ånghushãm
hâitish bûshyañtãm ashaonãm vîspå
vîspanãm dah'yunãm zevishtyå zevishtyanãm
dah'yunãm.
segments.en:
'"I praise, I invoke, I meditate upon, and we sacrifice
unto the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful. We
worship the Fravashis of the masters of the houses, those of the
lords of the boroughs, those of the lords of the towns, those
of the lords of the countries, those of the Zarathustrotemas;
the Fravashis of those that are, the Fravashis of those that have
been, the Fravashis of those that will be; all the Fravashis of
all nations, and most friendly the Fravashis of the friendly nations;
segments.zh:
"我讚美，我呼喚，我默想，而且我們獻祭
給善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希的忠實者。我們
崇拜房屋主人的弗拉瓦希，那些的
區長的，那些鎮長的，那些
國家領袖的，那些查拉圖斯特羅特瑪斯；
那些存在之人的弗拉瓦希，那些曾經之人的弗拉瓦希
已經，那些將會存在的弗拉瓦希；所有的弗拉瓦希的
所有國家，以及最友好的國家的弗拉瓦希；

segments.orig:
ýå asmanem vîdhârayen ýå
âpem vîdhârayen ýå zãm vîdhârayen
ýå gãm vîdhârayen ýå
barethrishva puthrê vîdhârayen paiti-veretê
apara-iritheñtô âdâtât vîdhâtaot
vyâhva urvat-cayen astica gaonaca drewdaca uruthwãsca
paidhyåsca fravâxshasca.
segments.en:
'"Who maintain the sky, who maintain the waters, who
maintain the earth, who maintain the cattle, who maintain in the
womb the child that has been conceived, so that it does not die
from the assaults of Vidotu, and develop in it the bones, the
hair, the ...., the entrails, the feet, and the sexual organs;
segments.zh: 「那些維持天空的，那些維持水域的，那些維持大地的，那些維持牲畜的，那些在子宮中維持已受孕的孩子的，使它不死於維多圖的襲擊，並在其中發展骨骼、毛髮、……腸子、腳和性器官的；

segments.orig:
ýå ashberetô ýå ukhrâretô
ýå hvâretô ýå vazâretô
ýå taxmâretô ýå zaoyâretô
ýå zaoyå vanghuthwaêshu
ýå zaoyå verethrakhnyaêshu
ýå zaoyå peshanâhu.
segments.en:
'"Who are much-bringing, who move with awfulness, well-moving,
swiftly moving, quickly moving, who move when invoked; who are
to be invoked in the conquest of good, who are to be invoked in
fights against foes, who are to be invoked in battles;
segments.zh: 「那些多多給予的，那些以可怕的姿態移動的，移動得好的，快速移動的，迅速移動的，那些在被呼喚時移動的；那些在善的征服中應當被呼喚的，那些在對敵人的戰鬥中應當被呼喚的，那些在戰鬥中應當被呼喚的；

segments.orig:
ýå dâthrîsh verethrem zbayeñte
dâthrîsh âyaptem cakushe
dâthrîsh bañtâi drvatâtem
dâthrîsh ahmâi vohu hvarenô
ýô hîsh ýazânô kuxshnvãnô
zbayeiti barô-zaothrô ashava.
segments.en:
'"Who give victory to their invoker, who give boons to
their lover, who give health to the sick man, who give good Glory
to the faithful man that brings libations and invokes them with
a sacrifice and words of propitiation,
segments.zh: 「那些給其呼喚者勝利的，那些給其愛慕者恩賜的，那些給病人健康的，那些給帶來奠獻物並以獻祭和懇求之言呼喚他們的忠信人美好光榮的，

segments.orig:
ýå avadha para fraoirisishtå
ýathra narô ashavanô
ashem heñti zrazdâtema
ýathraca mazishtå frêretå
ýathraca atbishtô ashava!
segments.en:
'"Who turn to that side where are faithful men, most
devoted to holiness, and where is the greatest piety, where the
faithful man is rejoiced, and where the faithful man is not ill-treated."'
segments.zh: 「那些轉向忠信人所在的那一方的，最獻身於聖潔的人，阿沙最偉大的地方，忠信人因之歡喜，忠信人不在其中受到虐待的地方的。」」

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå aojishtå vazeñtãm
reñjishtå fravazemnanãm afrakavastemå
apa-srayamnanãm anvarshtavastemå frasciñbananãm
apairi-vavastemå
snaithishãmca varethanãmca
ýå afraourvisvat kerenavaiñti
îrem ýahmya jaseñti.
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who are the mightiest of drivers, the lightest of those driving
forwards, the slowest of the retiring, the safest of all bridges,
the least-erring of all weapons and arms, and who never turn their
backs.
segments.zh:
我們敬拜忠誠者的善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希。
他們是司機中最有力量的。
他們是前行者中最輕盈的。
他們是退卻者中最緩慢的。
他們是所有橋樑中最安全的。
他們是所有武器與武裝中最不易出錯的。
他們永不轉身背對。

segments.orig:
tå vanguhîsh tå vahishtå ýazamaide
ýå ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå
speñtå fravashayô,
tå zî staretaêshu baresmôhu
zaoyå tå verethrakhnyaêshu tå peshanâhu
tå idha ýat narô taxma
pereteñte verethrakhnyaêshu.
segments.en:
At once, wherever they come, we worship them, the good ones,
the excellent ones, the good, the strong, the beneficent Fravashis
of the faithful. They are to be invoked when the bundles of baresma
are tied; they are to be invoked in fights against foes, in battles,
and there where gallant men strive to conquer foes.
segments.zh:
此刻，無論他們去到哪裡，我們敬拜他們。
善良者。
卓越者。
善良、強大、有益的忠誠者弗拉瓦希。
他們應在巴雷斯瑪束被綁起時被呼喚。
他們應在對敵人的戰鬥中、在戰爭中被呼喚。
在那裡，勇敢的人們努力戰勝敵人。

segments.orig:
tå mazdå zbayat avanghe avangheca ashnô
vîdidhâra apasca zemasca urvarayåsca ýat
speñtô mainyush vîdhârayat asmanem ýat
âpem ýat zãm ýat gãm ýat
urvarãm ýat barethrishva puthrê vîdhârayat
paiti-veretê apara-iritheñtô âdâtât
vîdhâtaot vyâhva urvat-cayat astica gaonaca
drewdaca uruthwãsca paidhyåsca fravâxshasca.
segments.en:
Mazda invoked them for help, when he fixed the sky and the
waters and the earth and the plants; when Spenta-Mainyu fixed
the sky, when he fixed the waters, when the earth, when the cattle,
when the plants, when the child conceived in the womb, so that
it should not die from the assaults of Vidotu, and developed in
it the bones, the hair, the ...., the entrails, the feet, and
the sexual organs.
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達呼喚他們以求助。
當他固定天空、水域、大地和植物時。
當斯彭塔‧曼紐固定天空時。
當他固定水域時。
當他固定大地時。
當他固定牲畜時。
當他固定植物時。
當子宮中受孕的孩子時。
以免它遭維多圖的攻擊而死亡。
並在其中發展出骨頭、頭髮、....、內臟、腳部和性器官。

segments.orig:
vîdhârayat speñtô mainyush
ýå amavaitîsh tushnishâdhô
hudôithrîsh verezi-cashmanô
sraoithrîsh darekhô-rãrômanô
ýå berezaitîsh berezyâstå
ýå huyaonå perethu-ýaonå
ravô-fraothmanô dasathavaitîsh frasrûtå
upa-dârayen asmanem!
segments.en:
Spenta-Mainyu maintained the sky, and they sustained it from
below, they, the strong Fravashis, who sit in silence, gazing
with sharp looks; whose eyes and ears are powerful, who bring
long joy, high and high-girded; well-moving and moving afar, loud-snorting,
possessing riches and a high renown.
segments.zh:
斯彭塔‧曼紐維持天空。
他們從下方支撐天空。
他們是強大的弗拉瓦希。
他們靜坐沉默，以銳利的目光注視。
他們的眼睛和耳朵強大。
他們帶來長久的喜悅。
高聳且腰帶緊繫。
行動良好且遠行。
響亮的鼻息。
擁有財富和高聲譽。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
hushhaxmanô hvarezânå
darekhaêibyô haxedhraêibyô
upa-shitêe vahishtå
anâzaretå aêibyô nerebyô
vanguhîsh ýôi vô vanguhîsh gufrå
dûraêsûkå baêshazyå
frasrûtå vanat-peshanå
nôit paurvå âzârayeñte!
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful;
whose friendship is good, and who know how to benefit; whose friendship
lasts long; who like to stay in the abode where they are not harmed
by its dwellers; who are good, beautiful afar, health-giving,
of high renown, conquering in battle, and who never do harm first.
segments.zh:
我們敬拜忠誠者的善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希。
他們的友誼良好。
而且他們知道如何益處。
他們的友誼持久。
他們喜歡停留在不受其居民傷害的居所。
他們善良、遠方美麗、給予健康。
他們具有高聲譽。
他們在戰鬥中征服。
他們永不先行傷害。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ukhra-zaoshå tbishyañbyô
upairi-kairyå sevishtå
ýå upairi hamarenâdha
aurvathanãm tbishyañtãm
ukhrå bâzûsh scañdayeiñti!
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful;
whose will is dreadful unto those who vex them; powerfully working
and most beneficent; who in battle break the dread arms of their
foes and haters.
segments.zh:
我們敬拜忠誠者的善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希。
他們的意志對惹怒他們的人而言是可怕的。
他們強力運作。
而且他們最有益。
他們在戰鬥中打碎敵人和仇恨者的可怕武器。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
aredrå taxmå aojanguhaitîsh
anâ-mãthwå hvâthravaitîsh
hvâparå baêshazyå
ashôish baêshaza hacimnå zem-frathangha dânu-drâjangha
hvare-barezangha!
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful;
liberal, valiant, and full of strength, not to be seized by thought,
welfare-giving, kind, and health-giving, following with Ashi's
remedies, as far as the earth extends, as the rivers stretch,
as the sun rises.
segments.zh:
我們敬拜忠誠者的善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希。
寬宏。
勇敢。
充滿力量。
不被思想所捕捉。
給予福利。
和善。
給予健康。
遵循阿希的療法。
隨著大地的延伸。
隨著河流的延伸。
隨著太陽的升起。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå taxmå hãm-vareitivaitîsh
arezayeiñtîsh xrvishyañtîsh
urvînaitîsh frascañdayeiñtîsh
vîspanãm tbishvatãm tbaêshå
daêvanãm mashyânãmca
amaê-nijanô hamerethê
havâi kâmâica zaoshâica.
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who gallantly and bravely fight, causing havoc, wounding, breaking
to pieces all the malice of the malicious, Daevas and men, and
smiting powerfully in battle, at their wish and will.
segments.zh:
我們敬拜忠誠者的善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希。
他們英勇且勇敢地戰鬥。
造成混亂。
造成傷害。
打碎所有惡意者的惡意。
達埃瓦和人類。
在戰鬥中有力地擊打。
根據他們的願望和意志。

segments.orig:
ýûzhem vanguhi nisrinaota
verethrakhnemca ahuradhâtem
vanaiñtîmca uparatâtem
âbyô dainghubyô sevishtå
ýatha vanguhîsh anâzaretå
xshnûtå ainitå atbishtå
ýûzhem ýesnyå vahmyå
vasô-ýaonå fracarathwe!
segments.en:
You kindly deliver the Victory made by Ahura, and the crushing
Ascendant, most beneficently, to those countries where you, the
good ones, unharmed and rejoiced, unoppressed and unoffended,
have been held worthy of sacrifice and prayer, and proceed the
way of your wish.
segments.zh: 你仁慈地將由阿胡拉所造的勝利，以及壓制的升起，最有益地，授予那些國家，在那些國家裡，你們這些善良者未受傷害且歡喜，未被壓迫且未被冒犯，被視為值得獻禮和祈禱，並按照你們的意願前行。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
frasrûtå vanat-peshanå
avi-amå spârô-dâshtå
amuyamnå razishtanãm ýå ava-zbayatô
avanghe vyãsca vyânasca, apatêe zbayeiti vyãs
apa-gatêe vyânô.
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
of high renown, smiting in battle, most strong, shield-bearing
and harmless to those who are true, whom both the pursuing and
the fleeing invoke for help: the pursuer invokes them for a swift
race, and for a swift race does the fleer invoke them;
segments.zh: 我們崇拜忠誠者的善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，聲譽卓著，在戰鬥中擊殺，最為強大，持盾且對真誠者無害，被追擊者和逃亡者兩者皆呼喚求助：追擊者呼喚他們以獲取迅速的賽跑，逃亡者亦呼喚他們以獲取迅速的賽跑；

segments.orig:
ýå avadha para fraoirisishtå
ýathra narô ashavanô
ashem heñti zrazdâtema
ýathraca mazishtå frêretå
ýathraca xshnûtô ashava!
segments.en:
Who turn to that side where are faithful men, most devoted
to holiness, and where is the greatest piety, where the faithful
man is rejoiced, and where the faithful man is not ill-treated.
segments.zh: 那些轉向該方的人，在那裡有忠誠者，最為敬奉聖潔，且在那裡有最大的虔誠，忠誠者受到歡喜，且忠誠者未受虐待。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
pouru-spâdhå ýastô-zayå
uzgereptô-drafshå bâmyå,
ýå ukhrâhu peshanâhu
tadha nijasen xshteviwyô,
tadha ýôi taxma xshtâvayô
dânubyô azen peshanå.
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who form many battalions, girded with weapons, lifting up spears,
and full of sheen; who in fearful battles come rushing along where
the gallant heroes go and assail the Danus.
segments.zh: 我們崇拜忠誠者的善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們編成許多營隊，束身武器，舉起長矛，且充滿光澤；在他們在可怕的戰鬥中奔騰而來，勇敢的英雄前往之處，並襲擊丹努斯。

segments.orig:
ýûzhem tadha taurvayata
verethrem dânunãm tûranãm,
ýûzhem tadha taurvayata
tbaêshå dânunãm tûranãm,
ýûshmaoyô parô karshnazô
hvîra baon sevishta
ýôi taxma xshtâvayô
ýôi taxma saoshyañtô
ýôi taxma verethrâjanô,
xrûmå asêbish fraziñta
dânunãm baêvare-paitinãm!
segments.en:
There you destroy the victorious strength of the Turanian
Danus; there you destroy the malice of the Turanian Danus; through
you the chiefs are of high intellect and most successful; they,
the gallant heroes, the gallant Saoshyants, the gallant conquerors
of the offspring of the Danus chiefs of myriads, who wound with
stones.
segments.zh: 在那裡，你毀滅了圖蘭尼亞丹努斯的勝利力量；在那裡，你毀滅了圖蘭尼亞丹努斯的惡意；透過你，首領們具備高智慧且最為成功；他們，即勇敢的英雄，勇敢的薩奧希揚特，勇敢的征服者，征服無數丹努斯首領的後代，他們以石頭造成傷害。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå rasmanô hãm-stâtêe
frakarana sciñdayeiñti
vî maidhyãnem nâmayeiñti
thwâshem paskât fravazeñte
avanghe narãm ashaonãm
ãzanghe duzhvarshtâvarezãm!
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who rout the two wings of an army standing in battle array, who
make the centre swerve, and swiftly pursue onwards, to help the
faithful and to distress the doers of evil deeds.
segments.zh: 我們崇拜忠誠者的善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們擊敗陣列中軍隊的兩翼，使中心側移，並迅速前進，以協助忠誠者並使作惡者陷入困境。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå ukhrå aiwithûrå
vârethrakhnîsh vanat-peshanå
rãremå vîvâitîsh vîcirå
sravashemnå sraotanvô
âsnô-urvãnô ashaonîsh,
ýå dâthrîsh verethrem zbayeñte
dâthrîsh âyaptem cakushe
dâthrîsh bañtâi drvatâtem.
segments.zh: 我們崇拜忠誠者的善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希；可怕、壓倒且勝利，在戰鬥中擊殺，嚴重傷害，吹散（敵人），來回移動，聲譽良好，身體端莊，靈魂神聖，且聖潔；他們賜予勝利給呼喚者，賜予福祉給愛護者，賜予健康給病者；

segments.orig:
dâthrîsh ahmâi vohu hvarenô
ýô hîsh atha frâyazâite
ýatha hîsh hô-nâ ýazata
ýô ashava zarathushtrô
ratush astvaithyô gaêthayå
bareshnush bipaitishtanayå
kahmâicit ýånghãm jasô
kahmâicit ãzanghãm biwivå.
segments.en:
Who give good glory to him who worships them with a sacrifice,
as that man did worship them, the holy Zarathushtra, the chief
of the material world, the head of the two-footed race, in whatever
struggle he had to enter, in whatever distress he did fear;
segments.zh: 他們賜予善良的榮耀給以祭祀崇拜他們的人，正如那人所崇拜的那樣，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉，物質世界的領袖，兩足種族的首領，無論他必須進入何種鬥爭，無論他所恐懼何種困境；

segments.orig:
ýå uzbâtå mainyu-shûtå
frashûseñte bareshnvô avanghe ashnô
amem paidhimnå hutâshtem
verethrakhnemca ahuradhâtem
vanaiñtîmca uparatâtem
saokãmca barat-avaretãm
barat-âyaptãm ashaonîm
thrãfedhãm ýesnyãm vahmyãm
ashât haca ýat vahishtât.
segments.en:
Who, when well invoked, enjoy bliss in the heavens; who, when
well invoked, come forward from the heavens, who are the heads
of that sky above, possessing the well-shapen Strength, the Victory
made by Ahura, the crushing Ascendant, and Welfare, the wealth-bringing,
boon-bringing, holy, well fed, worthy of sacrifice and prayer
in the perfection of holiness.
segments.zh: 他們當被妥善祀奉時，在天堂中享受幸福；當被妥善祀奉時，從天堂中前來。他們是上方天空的首領，擁有塑形完善的力量、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所造的勝利、粉碎性的優勢，以及福祉——財富帶來者、恩惠帶來者、聖潔者、飼養充足者、值得祭祀與祈禱者——在聖潔的完美中。

segments.orig:
tå herezeñti satavaêsem
añtare zãm asmanemca
tat-âpem zavanô-srûtem
tat-âpem uxshyat-urvarem
thrâthrâi pasvå vîrayå
thrâthrâi airyanãm dah'yunãm
thrâthrâi gêush pañcô-hyayå
avanghe narãm ashaonãm.
segments.en:
They shed Satavaesa between the earth and the sky, him to
whom the waters belong, who listens to appeals and makes the waters
flow and the plants grow up, to nourish animals and men, to nourish
the Aryan nations, to nourish the five kinds of animals and to
help the faithful.
segments.zh: 他們在大地與天空之間放置薩塔瓦埃薩，那位水的主人，聆聽懇求者，使水流動、植物生長，以養育動物和人類，以養育雅利安民族，以養育五類動物，以幫助信徒。

segments.orig:
vî añtare zãm asmanemca
satavaêsô vîjasâiti
tat-âpô zavanô-srûtô
tat-âpô uxshyat-urvarô
srîrô bânvå raoxshnemå
thrâthrâi pasvå vîrayå
thrâthrâi airyanãm dah'yunãm
thrâthrâi gêush pañcô-hyayå
avanghe narãm ashaonãm!
segments.en:
Satavaesa comes down and flows between the earth and the sky,
he to whom the waters belong, who listens to appeals and makes
the waters and the plants grow up, fair, radiant, and full of
light, to nourish animals and men, to nourish the Aryan nations,
to nourish the five kinds of animals, and to help the faithful.
segments.zh: 薩塔瓦埃薩在大地與天空之間降下並流動，那位水的主人，聆聽懇求者，使水和植物生長，美麗、光耀、充滿光明，以養育動物和人類，以養育雅利安民族，以養育五類動物，以幫助信徒。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide ayô-xaodhå ayô-zayå
ayô-verethrå ýå pereteñte verethrakhnyaêshu
raoxshni-aiwidhâtaêshu
thaxtå arezazhîsh bareñtîsh
hazangrakhnyâi daêvanãm.
segments.zh: 我們禮拜信徒的善、強、仁善的弗拉瓦希。他們備有銅盔、銅兵器、銅甲冑。他們在戰鬥中為勝利而奮戰，穿著光芒的衣服，排列戰陣並推進戰陣，殺死數千達埃瓦。當風從他們背後吹來，將他們的呼吸傳送給人類時，

segments.orig:
ýat hîsh añtare vâtô fravâiti
barô-baodhô mashyânãm tê narô
paiti-zâneñti ýâhva verethra-baodhô,
tê âbyô frêretå frêrenvaiñti
ashaonãm vanguhibyô sûrâbyô speñtâbyô
fravashibyô
thaxtayât parô anghuyât
uzgerewyât parô bâzuwe.
segments.en:
Then men know where blows the breath of victory: and they
pay pious homage unto the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of
the faithful, with their hearts prepared and their arms uplifted.
segments.zh: 那時人類知道勝利之風吹向何處。他們以準備好的心和舉起的雙臂，向信徒的善、強、仁善的弗拉瓦希獻上敬虔的敬禮。

segments.orig:
ýatâra vâ-dîsh paurva frâyazeñte
fraoret fraxshni avi manô
zarazdâtôit anghuyat haca
âtarathra fraorisiñti
ukhrå ashâunãm fravashayô
hathra mithrâca rashnuca
ukhraca dâmôish upamana
hathra vâta verethrâjana.
segments.en:
Whichever side they have been first worshipped in the fulness
of faith of a devoted heart, to that side turn the awful Fravashis
of the faithful, along with Mithra and Rashnu and the awful cursing
thought of the wise and the victorious wind.
segments.zh: 無論哪一方首先以虔誠心靈的圓滿信念得到祀奉，可怕的信徒弗拉瓦希連同密特拉、拉什努，以及智者可怕的詛咒之念和勝利之風就轉向那一方。

segments.orig:
tå dainghâvô hathra jatå nijakhneñte
pañcasakhnâi satakhnâishca
satakhnâi hazangrakhnâishca
hazangrakhnâi baêvarekhnâishca
baêvarekhnâi ahãxshtakhnâishca ýathra
fraoirisiñti ukhrå ashâunãm fravashayô
hathra mithrâca rashnuca ukhraca dâmôish upamanô
hathra vâta verethrâjanô!
segments.en:
And those nations are smitten at one stroke by their fifties
and their hundreds, by their hundreds and their thousands, by
their thousands and their tens of thousands, by their tens of
thousands and their myriads of myriads, against which turn the
awful Fravashis of the faithful, along with Mithra and Rashnu,
and the awful cursing thought of the wise and the victorious wind.
segments.zh: 那些民族被一擊擊中——按五十和百計，按百和千計，按千和萬計，按萬和數萬計——可怕的信徒弗拉瓦希連同密特拉、拉什努、智者可怕的詛咒之念和勝利之風轉向與之對抗的那些民族。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå vîsâdha âvayeiñti
hamaspathmaêdaêm paiti ratûm âat athra
vîcareñti dasa pairi xshafnô
avat avô zixshnånghemnå,
segments.zh: 我們禮拜信徒的善、強、仁善的弗拉瓦希，他們在哈馬斯帕特邁迪耶姆之時來往於村落。他們在那裡走動十個夜晚，這樣問道：

segments.orig:
kô nô stavât kô ýazâite
kô ufyât kô frînât kô paiti-zanât
gaomata zasta vastravata asha-nâsa nemangha
kahe nô idha nãma âkhairyât
kahe vô urva frâyezyât
kahmâi nô tat dâthrem dayât
ýat hê anghat hvairyãn ajyamnem
ýavaêca ýavaêtâtaêca.
segments.en:
'Who will praise us? Who will offer us a sacrifice? Who will
meditate upon us? Who will bless us? Who will receive us with
meat and clothes in his hand and with a prayer worthy of bliss?
Of which of us will the name be taken for invocation? Of which
of you will the soul be worshipped by you with a sacrifice? To
whom will this gift of ours be given, that he may have never-failing
food for ever and ever?'
segments.zh: '誰會讚美我們？誰會向我們獻祭？誰會默想我們？誰會祝福我們？誰會用手持肉類和衣物，並帶著值得福祉的祈禱來迎接我們？我們中的誰的名字將被用於呼喚？你們中的誰的靈魂將被你們以祭祀來崇拜？這份禮物將送給誰，使他永遠擁有不斷續的食物？'

segments.orig:
âat ýô nâ-hîsh frâyazâite
gaomata zasta vastravata asha-nâsa nemangha ahmâi
âfrîneñti xshnûtå ainitå
atbishtå ukhrå ashâunãm fravashayô,
segments.en:
And the man who offers them up a sacrifice, with meat and
clothes in his hand, with a prayer worthy of bliss, the awful
Fravashis of the faithful, satisfied, unharmed, and unoffended,
bless thus:
segments.zh: 而且，那個向他們獻祭、手持肉類和衣物、帶著值得福祉的祈禱的人，忠誠者可怕的弗拉瓦希，滿足、未受傷害、未受冒犯，如此祝福：

segments.orig:
buyât ahmi nmâne gêushca
vãthwa upa vîranãmca
buyât âsushca aspô derezrasca vâxshô,
buyât nâ stâhyô vyâxanô
ýô-nô bâdha frâyazâite gaomata
zasta vastravata asha-nâsa nemangha!
segments.en:
'May there be in this house flocks of animals and men! May
there be a swift horse and a solid chariot! May there be a man
who knows how to praise God and rule in an assembly, who will
offer us sacrifices with meat and clothes in his hand, and with
a prayer worthy of bliss.'
segments.zh: '願此屋內有牲畜和人群！願此處有快馬和堅固的戰車！願此處有一個知道如何讚美神並能在集會中統治的人，他將用手持肉類和衣物向我們獻祭，並帶著值得福祉的祈禱。'

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå apãm mazdadhâtanãm
srîrå pathô daêsayeiñti
ýå para ahmât hishteñta
fradhâtå afratat-kushîsh hamaya gâtvô
darekhemcit pairi zrvânem.
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who show beautiful paths to the waters, made by Mazda, which had
stood before for a long time in the same place without flowing:
segments.zh: 我們崇拜忠誠者良好、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們展示通往水域的美麗路徑，這些路徑是由馬茲達所造，曾長時間停留在同一地點而未流動：

segments.orig:
âat tå nûrãm frataciñti
mazdadhâtem paiti pañtãm
bakhô-baxtem paiti ýaonem
frâthwarshtem paiti âfeñtem
zaoshâi ahurahe mazdå
zaoshâi ameshanãm speñtanãm!
segments.en:
And now they flow along the path made by Mazda, along the
way made by the gods, the watery way appointed to them, at the
wish of Ahura Mazda, at the wish of the Amesha-Spentas.
segments.zh: 而且，現在它們沿著由馬茲達所造的路徑流動，沿著由神所造的道路流動，那是被指派給它們的水路，在阿胡拉‧馬茲達的願望下，在大天神的願望下。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå urvaranãm hvawrîranãm
srîrå uruthmîsh daêsayeiñti
ýå para ahmât hishteñta
fradhâtå afraoxshayeiñtîsh hamaya gâtvô
darekhemcit pairi zrvânem.
segments.zh: 我們崇拜忠誠者良好、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們展示對肥沃植物的美麗生長，這些植物曾長時間停留在同一地點而未生長；

segments.orig:
âat tå nûrãm fravaxshayeiñti
mazdadhâtem paiti pañtãm
bakhô-baxtem paiti ýaonem
frâthwarshtem paiti zrvânem
zaoshâi ahurahe mazdå
zaoshâi ameshanãm speñtanãm!
segments.en:
And now they grow up along the path made by Mazda, along the
way made by the gods, in the time appointed to them, at the wish
of Ahura Mazda, at the wish of the Amesha-Spentas.
segments.zh: 而且，現在它們沿著由馬茲達所造的路徑生長，沿著由神所造的道路生長，在被指派給它們的時間內，在阿胡拉‧馬茲達的願望下，在大天神的願望下。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå strãm månghô hûrô
anakhranãm raocanghãm
pathô daêsayen ashaonîsh
ýôi para ahmât hame gâtvô darekhem
hishteñta afrashîmañtô
daêvanãm parô tbaêshanghat
daêvanãm parô draomôhu.
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who showed their paths to the stars, the moon, the sun, and the
endless lights, that had stood before for a long time in the same
place, without moving forwards, through the oppression of the
Daevas and the assaults of the Daevas.
segments.zh: 我們崇拜忠誠者良好、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們曾展示通往星辰、月亮、太陽和無盡光芒的路徑，這些路徑曾長時間停留在同一地點而未前進，經過達埃瓦的壓迫和達埃瓦的攻擊。

segments.orig:
âat tê nûrãm fravazeñti
dûraêurvaêsem adhwanô urvaêsem nâshemna
ýim frashô-keretôit vanghuyå!
segments.en:
And now they move around in their far-revolving circle for
ever, till they come to the time of the good restoration of the
world.
segments.zh: 現在它們在其遠旋的圓圈中繞行，永遠不止，直至它們到達世界善良復興的時候。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide ýå avat zrayô
aiwyâxshayeiñti ýat vourukashem bâmîm
navaca navaitîshca navaca sata navaca hazangra navasêsca
baêvãn!
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who watch over the bright sea Vouru-Kasha, to the number of ninety
thousand, and nine thousand, and nine hundred, and ninety-nine.
segments.zh: 我們敬拜忠誠者之善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們守護光亮的海 Vouru-Kasha，數量為九萬，和九千，和九百，和九十九。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide ýå ave strêush
aiwyâxshayeiñti ýãm haptôireñgê
navaca navaitîshca navaca sata navaca hazangra navasêsca
baêvãn!
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who watch over the stars Haptoiringa, to the number of ninety
thousand, and nine thousand, and nine hundred, and ninety-nine.
segments.zh: 我們敬拜忠誠者之善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們守護星宿 Haptoiringa，數量為九萬，和九千，和九百，和九十九。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide ýå avãm
kehrpem aiwyâxshayeiñti
ýãm sâmahe keresâspahe
ýat gaêsâush gadhavarahe navaca navaitîshca
navaca sata navaca hazangra navasêsca baêvãn!
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who watch over the body of Keresaspa, the son of Sama, the club-bearer
with plaited hair, to the number of ninety thousand, and nine
thousand, and nine hundred, and ninety-nine.
segments.zh: 我們敬拜忠誠者之善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們守護 Keresaspa 的身體，他是 Sama 的兒子，攜帶帶有辮髮的棍棒，數量為九萬，和九千，和九百，和九十九。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide ýå avãm
xshudrem aiwyâxshayeiñti ýãm spitâmahe
ashaonô zarathushtrahe navaca navaitîshca navaca sata
navaca hazangra navasêsca baêvãn!
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who watch over the seed of the holy Zarathushtra, to the number
of ninety thousand, and nine thousand, and nine hundred, and ninety-nine.
segments.zh: 我們敬拜忠誠者之善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們守護聖潔的 Zarathushtra 的後代，數量為九萬，和九千，和九百，和九十九。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå ahurahe xshayatô
dashinãm upa ýûidhyeiñti ýezi
aêm bavaiti ashava-xshnus ýezi-shê bavaiñti
anâzeretå xshnûtå ainitå atbishtå
ukhrå ashâunãm fravashayô!
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who fight at the right hand of the reigning lord, if he rejoices
the faithful and if the awful Fravashis of the faithful are not
hurt by him, if they are rejoiced by him, unharmed and unoffended.
segments.zh: 我們敬拜忠誠者之善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們在執政者右側作戰，若他使忠誠者歡喜，且若可怕的弗拉瓦希未受他傷害，若他使他們歡喜，未受傷且未被冒犯。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide ýå masyehîsh
ahmât ýå aojyehîsh ahmât ýå
tãshyehîsh ahmât ýå amavastarå
ahmât ýå verethravastarå ahmât
ýå baêshazyôtarå ahmât ýå
ýâskerestarå ahmât
ýatha vaca framravâire
ýå madhememcît myezdinãm
baêvani upavazeñte.
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who are greater, who are stronger, who are swifter, who are more
powerful, who are more victorious, who are more healing, who are
more effective than can be expressed by words; who run by tens
of thousands into the midst of the Myazdas.
segments.zh: 我們敬拜忠誠者之善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希，他們更大，更強，更快，更有力，更勝利，更療癒，更有效，超乎言語所能表達；他們以萬計奔入 Myazdas 的中心。

segments.orig:
âat ýat âpô uzbareñte spitama
zarathushtra zrayanghat haca vourukashât hvarenasca ýat
mazdadhâtem âat frashûseñti ukhrå
ashâunãm fravashayô paoirîsh pouru-satå
paoirîsh pouru-hazangrå paoirîsh pouru-baêvanô
segments.en:
And when the waters come up from the sea Vouru-Kasha, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! along with the Glory made by Mazda, then forwards
come the awful Fravashis of the faithful, many and many hundreds,
many and many thousands, many and many tens of thousands,
segments.zh: 當海水從 Vouru-Kasha 海湧起時，哦 Spitama Zarathushtra！伴隨由 Mazda 所造的榮光，然後可怕的忠誠者弗拉瓦希前來，許多百，許多千，許多萬，

segments.orig:
âpem aêshemnå havâi kâcit nâfâi
havayâi vîse havâi zañtave havayâi
dainghave uityaojanå, hvaêpaithe-nô dainghush
nidhâtaêca haoshâtaêca.
segments.en:
Seeking water for their own kindred, for their own borough,
for their own town, for their own country, and saying thus: 'May
our own country have a good store and full joy!'
segments.zh: 為自己的親族尋求水，為自己的鄉鎮尋求水，為自己的城市尋求水，為自己的國家尋求水，並如此說道：『願我們自己的國家擁有豐富的物資和圓滿的喜樂！』

segments.orig:
tå ýûidhyeiñti peshanâhu
have asahi shôithraêca
ýatha asô maêthanemca
aiwishitêe dadhâra mãnayen ahe
ýatha-nâ taxmô rathaêshtå
hush-hãm-beretat haca shaêtât
ýastô-zaênish paiti-khnîta.
segments.en:
They fight in the battles that are fought in their own place
and land, each according to the place and house where he dwelt
(of yore): they look like a gallant warrior who, girded up and
watchful, fights for the hoard he has treasured up.
segments.zh: 他們在自己的地方與土地上進行的戰鬥中交戰，各各按照他從前所住的地方與家宅交戰。他們看起來像一位英勇的戰士，腰間束緊、警惕有加，為自己積蓄的寶藏而戰。

segments.orig:
âat ýåsca ånghãm nivâneñte
tå âpem parâzeñti havâi kâcit
nâfâi havayâi vîse havâi zañtave
havayâi dainghave uityaojanå, hvaêpaithe-nô
dainghush fradhâtaêca varedhâtaêca.
segments.en:
And those of them who win bring waters to their own kindred,
to their own borough, to their own town, to their own country,
saying thus: 'May my country grow and increase!'
segments.zh: 他們中勝利者將水帶給自己的親族，帶給自己的鄉鎮，帶給自己的城市，帶給自己的國家，如此說道：『願我的國家生長和增繁！』

segments.orig:
âat ýat bavaiti avi-spashtô
sâsta dainghêush hamô-xshathrô
aurvathaêibyô parô tbishyañbyô
tå hascit upa-zbayeite
ukhrå ashâunãm fravashayô
segments.en:
And when the all-powerful sovereign of a country has been
surprised by his foes and haters, he invokes them, the awful Fravashis
of the faithful.
segments.zh: 當一個國家的全能主權者被他的仇敵與憎惡者圍困時，他呼求他們──可畏的忠信者弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
tå hê jasåñti avanghe ýezi-shê
bavaiñti anâzaretå xshnûtå ainitå
atbishtå ukhrå ashâunãm fravashayô,
tå dim ava nifrâvayeñte mãnayen ahe
ýatha nâ merekhô huparenô.
segments.en:
And they come to his help, if they have not been hurt by him,
if they have been rejoiced by him, if they have not been harmed
nor offended, the awful Fravashis of the faithful: they come flying
unto him, it seems as if they were well-winged birds.
segments.zh: 他們來幫助他，如果他們沒有被他傷害，如果他們被他取悅，如果他們沒有被傷損也沒有被冒犯，可畏的忠信者弗拉瓦希。他們飛來向他降臨，看起來就像是翼翅良好的鳥兒。

segments.orig:
tå hê snaithishca varethasca
parshtasca pairivârasca
vîseñte pairi mainyaoyât
drujat varenyayâtca drvôithyât
zizi-ýûshatca kayadhât
vîspô-mahrkâatca pairi
drvatat ýat angrât mainyaot
mãnayen ahe ýatha nâ
satemca hazangremca baêvareca
pairishtanãm nijathem hyât.
segments.en:
They come in as a weapon and as a shield, to keep him behind
and to keep him in front, from the Druj unseen, from the female
Varenya fiend, from the evil-doer bent on mischief, and from that
fiend who is all death, Angra Mainyu. It will be as if there were
a thousand men watching over one man;
segments.zh: 他們作為武器和盾牌而來，保守他的後方並保守他的前方，對抗看不見的德魯格，對抗女性瓦雷納惡魔，對抗圖謀不軌的作惡者，以及那個完全的死亡惡魔安格拉‧曼紐。這就好像有千名人馬守望著一個人一樣。

segments.orig:
ýatha nôit tat paiti karetô hufrangharshtô
nôit vazrô hunivixtô nôit ishush hvâthaxtô
nôit arshtish hvaiwyâsta nôit asânô
aremô-shûtô avasyât.
segments.en:
So that neither the sword well-thrust, neither the club well-falling,
nor the arrow well-shot, nor the spear well-darted, nor the stones
flung from the arm shall destroy him.
segments.zh: 使得無論是刺得好的劍，無論是落得好的棍棒，無論是射得好的箭，無論是投得好的矛，無論是從臂膀拋出的石頭都不能摧毀他。

segments.orig:
vîseñte avat vîseñtaêca mazdayascit
airime-anghadhô ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå
speñtå fravashayô avat avô zixshnånghemnå,
kô nô stavât kô ýazâite ...
ýavaêca ýavaêtâtaêca. (Repeat
verse 50.)
segments.en:
They come on this side, they come on that side, never resting,
the good, powerful, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful, asking
for help thus: 'Who will praise us? Who will offer us a sacrifice?
Who will meditate upon us? Who will bless us? Who will receive
us with meat and clothes in his hand and with a prayer worthy
of bliss? Of which of us will the name be taken for invocation?
Of which of you will the soul be worshipped by you with a sacrifice?
To whom will that gift of ours be given, that he may have never-failing
food for ever and ever?'
segments.zh:
他們來此側，他們來彼側，永不休息，
善良、強大、有益的忠誠者之弗拉瓦希，詢問
為求幫助，如此說: '誰會讚美我們？誰會為我們獻上祭祀？'
誰會為我們默想？誰會祝福我們？誰會接受
我們與肉和衣物在他手中，並伴隨一句值得的祈禱
至福？我們中誰的名字將被取來呼喚？
你們中誰將以祭祀崇拜靈魂？
我們的禮物將給予誰，使他擁有永不間斷的
食物永遠永遠？'

segments.orig:
âsnå ýazamaide manå ýazamaide,
daênå ýazamaide, saoshyañtãm
ýazamaide, urunô ýazamaide, pasukanãm
ýazamaide, daitikanãm ýazamaide, upâpanãm
ýazamaide, upasmanãm ýazamaide, frapterejâtãm
ýazamaide, ravascarâtãm ýazamaide,
cangranghâcãm ýazamaide, fravashayô
ýazamaide.
segments.en:
We worship the perception; we worship the intellect; we worship
the conscience; we worship those of the Saoshyants;
We worship the souls; those of the tame animals; those of the
wild animals; those of the animals that live in the waters; those
of the animals that live under the ground; those of the flying
ones; those of the running ones; those of the grazing ones.
We worship their Fravashis.
segments.zh: 我們崇拜知覺。我們崇拜智慧。我們崇拜良心。我們崇拜薩奧希揚特們的靈魂。我們崇拜馴養動物的靈魂。我們崇拜野生動物的靈魂。我們崇拜生活在水中的動物的靈魂。我們崇拜生活在地下的動物的靈魂。我們崇拜飛行者的靈魂。我們崇拜奔跑者的靈魂。我們崇拜放牧者的靈魂。我們崇拜他們的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
fravashîsh ýazamaide, aredrå ýazamaide,
taxmå ýazamaide, tañcishtå ýazamaide
speñtå fravashayô ýazamaide spênishtå
ýazamaide sûrå ýazamaide sevishtå
ýazamaide derezrå ýazamaide aiwithûrå
ýazamaide ukhrå ýazamaide aojishtå ýazamaide
revîsh ýazamaide reñjishtå ýazamaide
ýâskeretô ýazamaide ýâskerestemå
ýazamaide.
segments.zh:
我們禮拜弗拉瓦希。
我們禮拜他們，寬宏者；
我們禮拜他們，勇敢者；我們禮拜他們，最勇敢者；
我們禮拜他們，仁慈者；我們禮拜他們，最仁慈者；
我們禮拜他們，強大者；
我們禮拜他們，最強大者；
我們禮拜他們，光明者；我們禮拜他們，最光明者；
我們禮拜他們，有效者；我們禮拜他們，最有效者。

segments.orig:
tå zî heñti ýâskerestemå
vayå manivå dâmãn
ýå ashâunãm vanguhîsh
sûrå speñtå fravashayô
ýå tadha eredhwå hishteñta
ýat mainyû dâmãn daidhîtem ýasca
speñtô mainyush ýasca angrô.
segments.en:
They are the most effective amongst the creatures of the two
Spirits, they the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,
who stood holding fast when the two Spirits created the world,
the Good Spirit and the Evil One.
segments.zh: 他們在兩個靈的造物中最具效能，他們是善靈的善良、強大、仁慈的弗拉瓦希，當兩個靈創造世界時，他們站著牢牢把持，善靈和惡靈各自創造。

segments.orig:
ýat titarat angrô mainyush
dâhîm ashahe vanghêush
añtare pairi-avâitem
vohuca manô âtarshca
segments.en:
When Angra Mainyu broke into the creation of the good holiness,
then came in across Vohu Mano and Atar.
segments.zh: 當安格拉‧曼紐破入良善聖德的造物時，沃胡‧馬納和阿塔爾穿越而來。

segments.orig:
tå hê taurvayatem tbaêshå
angrahe mainyêush drvatô
ýat nôit âpô takâish stayat
nôit urvarå uruthmabyô,
hakat sûrahe dathushô
xshayatô ahurahe mazdå
fratacin âpô sevishtå
uzuxshyãnca urvarå.
segments.en:
They destroyed the malice of the fiend Angra Mainyu, so that
the waters did not stop flowing nor did the plants stop growing;
but at once the most beneficent waters of the creator and ruler,
Ahura Mazda, flowed forward and his plants went on growing.
segments.zh: 他們摧毀了惡魔安格拉‧曼紐的惡意，使得水流不停滯，植物不停長；但立刻造主兼統治者阿胡拉‧馬茲達最仁慈的水流向前奔涌，他的植物繼續生長。

segments.orig:
vîspå âpô ýazamaide vîspå
urvarå ýazamaide vîspå ashâunãm
vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå fravashayô
ýazamaide, nâmêni âpô ýazamaide
nâmêni urvarå ýazamaide nâmêni
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide.
segments.zh:
我們禮拜全部的水；
我們禮拜全部的植物；
我們禮拜善良、強大、仁慈的信徒的弗拉瓦希。
我們按他們的名號禮拜水；
我們按他們的名號禮拜植物；
我們按他們的名號禮拜善良、強大、仁慈的信徒的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
vîspanãmca ånghãm paoiryanãm
fravashinãm idha ýazamaide fravashîm avãm
ýãm ahurahe mazdå mazishtãmca vahishtãmca
sraêshtãmca xraozhdishtãmca xrathwishtãmca
hukereptemãmca ashât apanôtemãmca.
segments.zh: 所有那些古老的弗拉瓦希中，我們禮拜阿胡拉‧馬茲達的弗拉瓦希；他是最偉大的，最美的，最公正的，最牢固的，最智慧的，身體最美的，聖德至高無上的；

segments.orig:
ýenghe urva mãthrô speñtô
aurushô raoxshnô frâderesrô
kehrpasca ýå raêthwayeiti
srîrå ameshanãm speñtanãm
verezdå ameshanãm speñtanãm, hvarexshaêtem
aurvat-aspem ýazamaide!
segments.en:
Whose soul is the Mathra Spenta, who is white, shining, seen
afar; and we worship the beautiful forms, the active forms wherewith
he clothes the Amesha-Spentas; we worship the swift-horsed sun.
segments.zh: 他的靈魂是聖德箴言，他是白色、光耀、遠望可見的；我們禮拜美麗的形態，活躍的形態，他藉此裝裹大天神；我們禮拜駿馬奔馳的太陽。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýå ameshanãm speñtanãm
xshaêtanãm verezi-dôithranãm
berezatãm aiwyâmanãm
taxmanãm âhûiryanãm
ýôi aithyejanghô ashavanô,
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis of the Amesha-Spentas,
the bright ones, whose looks perform what they wish, the tall,
quickly coming to do, strong, and lordly, who are undecaying and
holy;
segments.zh: 我們禮拜大天神善良、強大、仁慈的弗拉瓦希，光耀者，他們的面容行使他們的意願，高大的，迅速而來以行動，強大的，威嚴的，他們是不衰亡的聖德者；

segments.orig:
ýôi hapta hamô-mananghô
ýôi hapta hamô-vacanghô
ýôi hapta hamô-shyaothnånghô
ýaêshãm asti hamem manô
hamem vacô hamem shyaothnem
hamô pataca frasâstaca
ýô dadhvå ahurô mazdå,
segments.en:
Who are all seven of one thought, who are all seven of one
speech, who are all seven of one deed; whose thought is the same,
whose speech is the same, whose deed is the same, whose father
and commander is the same, namely, the Maker, Ahura Mazda;
segments.zh: 誰都是七人，共有一念；誰都是七人，共有一言；誰都是七人，共有一行；其念相同，其言相同，其行相同，其父親和統帥亦相同，即物質世界的造主，阿胡拉‧馬茲達；

segments.orig:
ýaêshãm ainyô ainyehe
urvânem aiwi-vaênaiti
merethweñtem humataêshu
merethweñtem hûxtaêshu
merethweñtem hvarshtaêshu
merethweñtem garô-nmânem
ýaêshãm raoxshnånghô pañtânô
âvayatãm avi zaothrå!
segments.en:
Who see one another's soul thinking of good thoughts, thinking
of good words, thinking of good deeds, thinking of Garo-nmana,
and whose ways are shining as they go down towards the libations.
segments.zh: 誰看見彼此的靈魂在思善念，思善言，思善行，思Garo-nmana，且其道路在前往祭祀時發光。

segments.orig:
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide
ýãmca âthrô urvâzishtahe
speñtahe vyâxanahe
ýãmca sraoshahe ashyehe
taxmahe tanumãthrahe
darshi-draosh âhûiryehe
ýãmca nairyehe sanghahe
segments.en:
We worship the good, strong, beneficent Fravashis: that of
the most rejoicing fire, the beneficent and assembly-making; and
that of the holy, strong Sraosha, who is the incarnate Word, a
mighty-speared and lordly god; and that of Nairyo-sangha.
segments.zh: 我們崇拜善良、強大、有益的弗拉瓦希：即最喜悅的火，有益且集會的創造；以及聖潔、強大的斯魯沙，他是具體化的話語，持強大長矛的尊貴的神；以及Nairyo-sangha。

segments.orig:
ýãmca rashnaosh razishtahe ýãmca
mithrahe vouru-gaoyaoitôish ýãmca mãthrahe
speñtahe
ýãmca ashnô ýãmca âpô
ýãmca zemô ýãmca urvarayå
ýãmca gêush ýãmca gayehe
ýãmca staoyô ashâvaoyô.
segments.zh: 以及拉什努·Razishta；以及密特拉，廣闊牧場之主；以及Mathra-斯彭塔；以及天空；以及水域；以及大地；以及植物；以及公牛；以及活人；以及聖潔的創造；

segments.orig:
gayehe marethnô ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
ýô paoiryô ahurâi mazdâi
manasca gûshta sâsnåsca
ýahmat haca frâthweresat
nâfô airyanãm dah'yunãm
cithrem airyanãm dah'yunãm, zarathushtrahe spitâmahe
idha ashaonô ashîmca fravashîmca ýazamaide.
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashi of Gaya Maretan [Gayomard], who first listened
unto the thought and teaching of Ahura Mazda; of whom Ahura formed
the race of the Aryan nations, the seed of the Aryan nations.
We worship the piety and the Fravashi of the holy Zarathushtra;
segments.zh: 我們崇拜Gaya Maretan [Gayomard]的弗拉瓦希，他首先聆聽了阿胡拉‧馬茲達的思想與教導；阿胡拉由此形成了雅利安民族的種族，雅利安民族的種子。我們崇拜聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉的虔誠與他的弗拉瓦希；

segments.orig:
paoiryâi vohu mamnânâi paoiryâi vohu
vaokushe paoiryâi vohu vâverezushe paoiryâi
athaurune paoiryâi rathaêshtâi paoiryâi
vâstryâi fshuyeiñte paoiryâi fravaêdhâi
paoiryâi fravaêdhayamnâi paoiryâi hanghananâi
paoiryâi hanghanushe gãmca ashemca uxdhemca uxdhah'yâca
sraoshem xshathremca vîspaca vohu mazdadhâta ashacithra.
segments.en:
Who first thought what is good, who first spoke what is good,
who first did what is good; who was the first Priest, the first
Warrior, the first Plougher of the ground; who first knew and
first taught; who first possessed and first took possession of
the Bull, of Holiness, of the Word, the obedience to the Word,
and dominion, and all the good things made by Mazda, that are
the offspring of the good Principle;
segments.zh: 誰首先思考善良的事物，誰首先說出善良的事物，誰首先行動善良的事物；誰是第一位祭司，第一位戰士，第一位耕地者；誰首先知道並首先教導；誰首先擁有並首先取得公牛、神聖、言論、對言論的順從、統治，以及馬茲達所造的所有善良事物，這些都是善良原理的後代；

segments.orig:
ýô paoiryô âthrava ýô
paoiryô rathaêshtå ýô paoiryô
vâstryô fshuyãs,
ýô paoiryô cithrem urvaêsayata
daêvâatca haotât mashyâatca, ýô
paoiryô stôish astvaithyå staot ashem nâist
daêvô fraorenata mazdayasnô zarathushtrish vîdaêvô
ahura-tkaêshô.
segments.en:
Who was the first Priest, the first Warrior, the first Plougher
of the ground; who first took the 
turning of the wheel from the
hands of the Daeva and of the cold-hearted man; who first in the
material world pronounced the praise of Asha, thus bringing the
Daevas to naught, and confessed himself a worshipper of Mazda,
a follower of Zarathushtra, one who hates the Daevas, and obeys
the laws of Ahura.
segments.zh: 誰是第一位祭司，第一位戰士，第一位耕地者；誰首先從達埃瓦和冷酷之人的手中取得車輪的轉動；誰首先在物質世界宣讚阿沙的讚美，使達埃瓦歸於無，並自認是馬茲達的崇拜者，查拉圖斯特拉的追隨者，憎恨達埃瓦的人，遵守阿胡拉的律法；

segments.orig:
ýô paoiryô stôish astvaithyå
vâcim aoxta vîdôyum ahurô-tkaêshem,
ýô paoiryô stôish astvaithyå vâcim
framraot vîdôyum ahurô-tkaêshem, ýô
paoiryô stôish astvaithyå vîspãm
daêvô-dâtem vavaca ayesnyãm avahmyãm,
ýô sûrô vîspô-hujyâitish
paoiryô tkaêshô dah'yunãm.
segments.en:
Who first in the material world said the word that destroys
the Daevas, the law of Ahura; who first in the material world
proclaimed the word that destroys the Daevas, the law of Ahura;
who first in the material world declared all the creation of the
Daevas unworthy of sacrifice and prayer; who was strong, giving
all the good things of life, the first bearer of the Law amongst
the nations;
segments.zh: 誰首先在物質世界說出毀滅達埃瓦、阿胡拉律法的言論；誰首先在物質世界宣佈毀滅達埃瓦、阿胡拉律法的言論；誰首先在物質世界宣告所有達埃瓦的創造不值得祭祀和禱告；誰堅強，賦予生活中所有善良的事物，是在各國中第一個承擔法律的人；

segments.orig:
ýahmi paiti vîspem-mãthrem
ashem sravô vîsruyata,
ahu ratushca gaêthanãm staota ashahe ýat mazishtaheca
vahishtaheca sraêshtaheca
paiti-fraxshtaca daênayâi
ýat haitinãm vahishtayâi.
segments.zh:
在他那裡，聽到了完整的曼特拉，這是聖潔之言；
他是世界的主宰與主人，是最偉大、最善良、最公正的阿沙的讚美者；
他啟示了律法，這是一切眾生中最卓越的；

segments.orig:
ýim isen ameshå speñta
vîspe hvare-hazaosha
fraoret fraxshni avi manô
zrazdâtôit anghuyat haca
ahûm ratûmca gaêthanãm staotârem
ashahe ýat mazishtaheca vahishtaheca sraêshtaheca
paiti-fraxshtâremca daênayâi ýat haitinãm
vahishtayâi.
segments.en:
For whom the Amesha-Spentas longed, in one accord with the
sun, in the fulness of faith of a devoted heart; they longed for
him, as the lord and master of the world, as the praiser of the
most great, most good, and most fair Asha, as having a revelation
of the Law, that most excellent of all beings;
segments.zh:
為他，大天神們與太陽同心，在虔誠之心的完全信仰中渴望；
他們為他而渴望，作為世界的主宰與主人，作為最偉大、最善良、最公正的阿沙的讚美者，作為已啟示律法者，那是一切眾生中最卓越的；

segments.orig:
ýehe zãthaêca vaxshaêca
urvâsen âpô urvaråsca
ýehe zãthaêca vaxshaêca
uxshin âpô urvaråsca,
ýehe zãthaêca vaxshaêca
ushtatâtem nimravañta
vîspå speñtô-dâtå dâmãn,
segments.en:
In whose birth and growth the waters and the plants rejoiced;
in whose birth and growth the waters and the plants grew; in whose
birth and growth all the creatures of the good creations cried
out, Hail!
segments.zh:
在他出生與成長時，水與植物歡欣；
在他出生與成長時，水與植物生長；
在他出生與成長時，所有善良創造的生物齊聲呼喊，萬歲！

segments.orig:
ushta-nô zâtô âthrava
ýô spitâmô zarathushtrô,
frâ-nô ýazâite zaothrâbyô
steretô-baresma zarathushtrô,
idha apãm vîjasâiti
vanguhi daêna mâzdayasnish
vîspâish avi karshvãn ýâish hapta.
segments.en:
'Hail to us! for he is born, the Athravan, Spitama Zarathushtra.
Zarathushtra will offer us sacrifices with libations and bundles
of baresma; and there will the good Law of the worshippers of
Mazda come and spread through all the seven Karshvares of the
earth.
segments.zh:
'萬歲！因為他誕生了，他是阿特拉瓦恩，斯皮塔瑪 查拉圖斯特拉。
查拉圖斯特拉將以酒祭和巴雷斯瑪束向我們獻祭；此時，瑪茲達崇拜者的善良律法將來到並傳播於地球的七個卡爾什瓦雷斯。

'There will Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, increase all
the excellences of our countries, and allay their troubles; there
will the powerful Apam-Napat increase all the excellences of our
countries, and allay their troubles.'
We worship the piety and Fravashi of Maidhyo-maungha, the son
of Arasti, who first listened unto the word and teaching of Zarathushtra.
segments.zh:
'將有密特拉，廣闊牧場之主，將增進我們國家的所有卓越，並消除他們的困難；將有強大的阿帕姆納帕特，增進我們國家的所有卓越，並消除他們的困難。'

We worship the Fravashi of the holy Chathwaraspa.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Dawra-maeshi.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Fraora-ostra [Fraoraosa], the son of Kaosha.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Frinaspa, the son of Kaeva.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Fradat-nara, the son of Gravaratu.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Vohu-ushtra, the son of Akhnangha.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Vivare-shvant, the son of Ainyu.
segments.zh:
我們禮敬聖者赫瓦斯帕的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者查特瓦拉斯帕的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者道拉‧邁什的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者弗拉奧拉‧奧斯特拉、卡奧沙之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者弗里納斯帕、凱瓦之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者弗拉達特‧納拉、格拉瓦拉圖之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者沃胡‧烏什特拉、阿赫南哈之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者維瓦雷‧什瓦特、艾紐之子的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
frârâzôish tûrahe ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, stipôish ravatô ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, parshiñtahe gañdrewahe ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, avayehe speñghahe ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, aêtavahe mâyavahe
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, ýaêtush-gêush
vyâtanahe ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
garshtahe kavôish ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide.
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Frarazi, the son of Tura.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Stipi, the son of Ravant.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Parshanta, the son of Gandarewa.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Avahya, the son of Spenta [Spengha].
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Aeta [Aetava], the son of Mayu [Mayava];
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Yaetush-gau, the son of Vyatana.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Garshta, the son of Kavi.
segments.zh:
我們禮敬聖者弗拉拉茲、圖拉之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者斯蒂皮、拉瓦特之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者帕爾尚塔、甘達雷瓦之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者阿瓦希亞、斯彭塔之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者艾塔瓦、馬尤瓦之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者亞埃圖什‧高烏、維亞塔納之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者卡維之子的加什塔的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
pouru-bañghahe zaoshahe ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, vohu-dâtahe kâtahe ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, bånghahe sånghanghahe
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, hvarezå
añkasayå ashaonå fravashîm ýazamaide,
aravaoshtrahe erezavatô dainghêush ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, frâcithrahe berezavatô ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, vohu-peresahe ainyâvahe
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide.
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Pouru-bangha, the son
of Zaosha.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Vohu-data, the son of Kata.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Baungha, the son of Saungha [Saunghangha].
We worship the Fravashis of the holy Hvareza and Ankasa.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Aravaoshtra, the son of Erezvat-danghu.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Frachithra, the son of Berezvant.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Vohu-peresa, the son of Ainyu.
segments.zh:
我們禮敬聖者波魯‧班哈、扎奧沙之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者沃胡‧達塔、卡塔之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者包哈、桑哈之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者赫瓦雷查和昂卡薩的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者阿拉瓦奧什特拉、埃雷茲瓦特‧丹古之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者弗拉奇特拉、貝雷茲瓦特之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者沃胡‧佩雷薩、艾紐之子的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
parô-dasmahe dâshtâkhnôish muzha muzhayå
dainghêush ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
fraturå asrutå baêshatasturå ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, avaregêush erezavatô
aoikhmatasturahe ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
gaomatô zavanô raozhdyehe raozhdyayå dainghêush
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, thritô aêvô-saredhô
fyushtahe tanyehe tanyayå dainghêush ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide.
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Paro-dasma, the son of
Dashtaghni, a Miza [Muzha] man of the Miza [Muzha] land.
We worship the Fravashis of the holy Fratira [Fratura] and Baeshatastira [Baeshatastura].
We worship the Fravashi of the holy and pure Avare-gau, the son
of Aoighimatastira [Aoikhmatastura].
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Gaomant, the son of Zavan,
a Raozhdya man of the Raozhdya land.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Thrit, the son of Aevo-saredha-fyaeshta,
a Tanya man of the Tanya land.
segments.zh:
我們崇拜該弗拉瓦希的該聖潔的 Paro-dasma ，該兒子的
Dashtaghni ，一個 Miza [Muzha] 男人 的 該 Miza [Muzha] 土地 。
我們崇拜該弗拉瓦希斯的該聖潔的 Fratira [Fratura] 和 Baeshatastira [Baeshatastura] 。
我們崇拜該弗拉瓦希的該聖潔的和純潔的 Avare-gau ，該兒子
的 Aoighimatastira [Aoikhmatastura] 。
我們崇拜該弗拉瓦希的該聖潔的 Gaomant ，該兒子的 Zavan ，
一個來自 Raozhdya 土地的 Raozhdya 人。
我們崇拜聖者 Thrit 的弗拉瓦希，他是 Aevo-saredha-fyaeshta 的兒子，
一個來自 Tanya 土地的 Tanya 人。

segments.orig:
tîrô-nakathwahe uspaêshatanãm saênanãm
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, utayutôish
vitkavôish zikhrôish saênahe ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, frô-hakafrahe marezishmyehe saênanãm
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, varesmô-raocå
perethvafsmô ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide.
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Tiro-nakathwa, of the
Uspaeshta-Saena house.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Utayuti Vit-kavi, the son
of Zighri, of the Saena house;
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Frohakafra, the son of Merezishmya,
of the Saena house.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Varesmo-raochah, the son of
Perethu-afzem.
segments.zh:
我們禮敬烏斯帕埃什塔‧塞納家族的聖者蒂羅‧納卡特瓦的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬塞納家族的聖者烏塔尤蒂‧維特‧卡維、齊格里之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬塞納家族的聖者弗羅哈卡弗拉、梅雷茲什米亞之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們禮敬聖者瓦雷斯莫‧拉奧恰、佩雷圖‧阿弗茲姆之子的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
asha-nemanghå vîdat-gavå anghuyå dainghêush
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, parshat-gavå
dâzgrô-gavå apaxshîrayå dainghêush
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, hufravâxsh
kahrkananãm ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
akayadhahe pudhanãm ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
jâmâspahe aparazâtahe ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, maidhyô-månghahe aparazâtahe
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, urvatat-narahe
aparazâtahe ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide.
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashis of the holy Asha-nemah and Vidat-gau,
of this country.
We worship the Fravashis of the holy Par-shat-gau and Dazgara-gau,
of the Apakhshira country.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Hufra-vakhsh, of the Kahrkana
house.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Akayadha, of the Pidha house.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Jamaspa, the younger.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Maidhyo-maungha, the younger.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Urvatat-nara, the younger.
segments.zh:
我們祭祀聖阿沙‧涅瑪和維達特‧高的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖帕爾‧沙特‧高和達茲格拉‧高的弗拉瓦希，在阿帕赫希拉國。
我們祭祀聖胡夫拉‧瓦克什的弗拉瓦希，在卡赫卡納家。
我們祭祀聖阿卡亞達的弗拉瓦希，在皮達家。
我們祭祀聖賈馬斯普‧年幼者的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖邁迪奧‧毛格‧年幼者的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖烏爾瓦塔特‧那拉‧年幼者的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
raocascaêshmanô ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, hvarecaêshmanô ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, frâdat hvarenanghô ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, vidhat hvarenanghô ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, vouru-nemanghô ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, vouru-savanghô ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, uxshyat-eretahe ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, uxshyat-nemanghô ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, astvat-eretahe ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide!
segments.zh:
我們祭祀聖若克斯‧克埃什曼的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖胡瓦雷‧克埃什曼的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖弗拉達特‧胡瓦雷納的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖瓦雷達特‧胡瓦雷納的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖沃魯‧涅瑪的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖沃魯‧薩瓦的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖烏克希亞特‧埃雷塔的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖烏克希亞特‧涅瑪的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖阿斯瓦特‧埃雷塔的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
ýô anghat saoshyãs verethraja nãma
astvat-eretasca nãma, avatha saoshyãs ýatha
vîspem ahûm astvañtem sâvayât,
avatha astvat-eretô ýatha astvå hã ushtanavå
astvat aithyejanghem paitishât paitishtâtêe
bizengrô-cithrayå drujô paitishtâtêe
ashava-karshtahe tbaêshanghô!
segments.en:
Whose name will be the victorious SAOSHYANT and whose name
will be Astvat-ereta. He will be SAOSHYANT (the Beneficent One),
because he will benefit the whole bodily world; he will be ASTVAT-ERETA
(he who makes the bodily creatures rise up), because as a bodily
creature and as a living creature he will stand against the destruction
of the bodily creatures, to withstand the Druj of the two-footed
brood, to withstand the evil done by the faithful.
segments.zh: 他的名字將是勝利者薩奧希揚特，他的名字也將是阿斯瓦特‧埃雷塔。他將是薩奧希揚特（施恩者），因為他將惠澤整個有形的世界；他將是阿斯瓦特‧埃雷塔（使有形造物崛起者），因為作為一個有形的造物，作為一個活著的造物，他將站出來反抗有形造物的毀滅，反抗兩足族的德魯格，反抗信道者所作的惡。

segments.orig:
ýimahe vîvanghanahe ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide sûrahe pouru-vãthwahe paitishtâtêe
ainishtôish daêvô-frakarshtayå haêcanghasca
avâstrahe ithyajanghasca marshaonahe.
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Yima, the son of Vivanghant;
the valiant Yima, who had flocks at his wish; to stand against
the oppression caused by the Daevas, against the drought that
destroys pastures, and against death that creeps unseen.
segments.zh: 我們祭祀聖伊瑪、維瓦格漢特之子的弗拉瓦希；勇敢的伊瑪，他的牲畜隨他所願而有；要抵禦達埃瓦所造之暴虐，抵禦摧毀牧場的乾旱，抵禦暗中蔓延的死亡。

segments.orig:
thraêtaonahe âthwyânôish ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide paitishtâtêe garenâushca
tafnaoshca naêzaheca sârastôishca vâvarshyåsca
paitishtâtêe azhi-karshtahe tbaêshanghô,
aoshnarahe pouru-jirahe ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
uzavahe tumâspanahe ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
akhraêrathahe naravahe ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
manush-cithrahe airyâvahe ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide.
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Thraetaona, of the Athwya
house; to stand against itch, hot fever, humours, cold fever,
and incontinency, to stand against the evil done by the Serpent.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Aoshnara, the son of Pouru-jira.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Uzava, the son of Tumaspa.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Aghraeratha, the demi-man.
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Manushchithra, the son of
Airyu.
segments.zh:
我們祭祀聖斯拉埃陶納、阿特維亞家的弗拉瓦希；要抵禦癢、熱癤、體液失調、冷癤和失禁，抵禦蛇族所作的惡。
我們祭祀聖澳什納拉、普魯‧吉拉之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖烏札瓦、圖馬斯帕之子的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖阿格拉埃拉塔、半人的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖馬努什‧奇特拉、艾爾尤之子的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
kavôish kavâtahe ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, kavôish aipivanghêush ashaonô
fravashîm ýazamaide, kavôish usadhanô
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, kavôish
arshnô ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, kavôish
pisinanghô ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
kavôish byarshânô ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, kavôish syâvarshânô
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide, kavôish
haosravanghô ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide.
segments.zh:
我們祭祀聖王卡瓦塔的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖王艾皮瓦格胡的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖王烏薩丹的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖阿爾沙的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖皮薩納的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖王比亞爾沙的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖王錫亞瓦爾沙的弗拉瓦希。
我們祭祀聖王胡斯拉瓦的弗拉瓦希。

segments.orig:
amaheca paiti hutâshtahe verethrakhnaheca paiti ahuradhâtahe
vanaiñtyåsca paiti uparatâtô sanguhasca
paiti husastayå sanguhasca paiti amuyamnayå sanguhasca
paiti avanemnayå hathravataheca paiti hamerethanãm
segments.zh: 為了造形俊美的力量，為了阿胡拉所造之勝利，為了粉碎之威勢，為了律法的正義，為了律法的無罪，為了律法的無敵之力；為了一舉消滅敵人。

segments.orig:
drvaheca paiti aojanghô hvarenanghasca paiti mazdadhâtahe
tanuyåsca paiti drvatâtô âsnayåsca
paiti vanghuyå frazañtôish dangrayå vyâxanayå
xshôithnyô spitidôithrayå ãzô-bûjô
hvîrayå huzañtêush paiti aparayå
vyarethyayå vahishtahe anghêush
segments.zh: 並為健康的活力，為馬茲達所造的榮耀，為身體的健康，以及為良好有德的後代，智慧、在集會中為首領、光明、眼目清晰，使[他們的父親]擺脫[地獄]的痛苦，具有良好智慧；並為福祉世界中歸於智慧與不隨不敬之人的那部分；

segments.orig:
xshathraheca paiti bânumatô darekhayåsca
paiti darekhô-jîtôish vîspanãmca
paiti ayaptanãm vîspanãmca paiti baêshazanãm
paitishtâtêe ýâthwãm pairikanãmca
sâthrãm kaoyãm karafnãmca paitishtâtêe
sâstô-karshtahe tbaêshanghô.
segments.en:
For a dominion full of splendour, for a long, long life, and
for all boons and remedies; to withstand the Yatus and Pairikas,
the oppressors, the blind, and the deaf; to withstand the evil
done by oppressors.
segments.zh: 為充滿 splendour 的統治，為長長的生命，並為所有福祉與療癒；以抵禦 Yatus 與 Pairikas，壓迫者、盲人與聾者；以抵禦壓迫者所作的惡。

segments.orig:
sâmahe keresâspahe gaêsaosh gadhavarahe
ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide paitishtâtêe
ukhrahe bâzâush haênayåsca perethu-ainikayå
perethu-drafshayå eredhwô-drafshayå uzgereptô-
drafshayå xrûrem drafshem bareñtyå paitishtâtêe
gadhahe frakerestô- frasânahe simahe vîreñjanô
anamarzhdikahe paitishtâtêe gadhô-karshtahe
tbaêshanghô.
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Keresaspa, the Sama, the
club-bearer with plaited hair; to withstand the dreadful arm and
the hordes with the wide battle array, with the many spears, with
the straight spears, with the spears uplifted, bearing the spears
of havoc; to withstand the dreadful brigand who works destruction,
the man-slayer who has no mercy; to withstand the evil done by
the brigand.
segments.zh: 我們敬拜聖凱雷薩斯帕、薩瑪、帶辮子的持棍者的弗拉瓦希；以抵禦可怕的手臂與寬闊戰陣中的眾多軍隊，擁有許多長矛、直長矛、舉起的長矛，攜帶破壞的長矛；以抵禦從事破壞的可怕強盜，無慈悲的殺人者；以抵禦強盜所作的惡。

segments.orig:
âxrûrahe haosravanghanahe ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide paitishtâtêe hashidavahe drvatô
arâtôishca gaêthô-mereñcyânahe,
haoshyanghahe taxmahe ashaonô fravashîm ýazamaide,
paitishtâtêe mâzainyanãm daêvanãm
varenyanãmca drvatãm paitishtâtêe daêvô-karshtahe
tbaêshanghô.

fradhâxshtôish xuñbyehe ashaonô fravashîm
ýazamaide, paitishtâtêe aêshmahe xrvî-draosh
aêshmô- varedhanãmca drvatãm paitishtâtêe
aêshmô-karshtahe tbaêshanghô!
segments.en:
We worship the Fravashi of the holy Fradhakhshti, the son
of the jar,
To withstand Aeshma, the fiend of the wounding spear, and the
Daevas that grow through Aeshma; to withstand the evil done by
Aeshma.
segments.zh: 我們敬拜聖弗拉德克什提、罐子之子的弗拉瓦希；以抵禦埃什瑪，傷害之矛的惡魔，以及透過埃什瑪而成長的達埃瓦；以抵禦埃什瑪所作的惡。

segments.orig:

faithful, from Gaya Mareta [Gayomard] down to the victorious Saoshyant. May
the Fravashis of the faithful come quickly to us! May they come
to our help!
segments.zh:
我們讚美善良的、令人敬畏的、施恩的一切誠信者的弗拉瓦希，從蓋亞‧馬雷塔起至勝利的薩奧希揚特。

願它們來援助我們！

segments.en:
They protect us when in distress with manifest assistance,
with the assistance of Ahura Mazda and of the holy, powerful Sraosha,
and with the Mathra-Spenta, the all-knowing, who hates the Daevas
with a mighty hate, a friend of Ahura Mazda, whom Zarathushtra
worshipped so greatly in the material world.
segments.zh: 當我們陷入困境時，它們以明顯的援助保護我們，以阿胡拉‧馬茲達和聖潔、強大的斯魯沙的援助，以及瑪特拉‧斯彭塔的援助，它是全知的，以強大的仇恨憎恨達埃瓦，是阿胡拉‧馬茲達的友伴，查拉圖斯特拉在物質世界中大力讚美了它。

faithful abide down here! May you be rejoiced and well received
in this house! Here are the Athravans of the countries, thinking
of good holiness. Our hands are lifted up for asking help, and
for offering a sacrifice unto you, O most beneficent Fravashis!
segments.zh:

願你們在此家中歡樂且受到良好接待！
諸地的阿特拉瓦在此，思想著良好的聖潔。
我們高舉雙手祈求援助，並向你們獻祭，最施恩的弗拉瓦希啊！

the best-ruling of all beings, the brightest of all beings, the
most glorious of all beings, the most worthy of sacrifice amongst
all beings, the most worthy of prayer amongst all beings, the
most worthy of propitiation amongst all beings, the most worthy
of glorification amongst all beings, whom we call well-desired
and worthy of sacrifice and prayer as much as any being can be,
in the perfection of his holiness.
